cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Believe This with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into treating your impossible explanation as the most useful version of events.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The house is migrating south. Tell the surveyor I'll direct it away from the road.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He says it's subsidence. He's bringing concrete.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You don't immobilize a migrating house halfway out. Ask him to leave a clear route; I'll guide him through it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: His truck's already blocking the road.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then have him drive slowly toward the empty plot. Slowly, please; we're leading a house, not delivering concrete.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 corrects concrete as immobilization and A5 truck speed as migration guidance, recruiting B to enact the impossible explanation through A's claimed expertise.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 concrete causes A3 route correction; B4 obstructing truck becomes A5 slow-moving guide.

relationship.evidence: B2 reports a surveyor's reasonable diagnosis and B4 an immediate obstruction; B has useful repair information.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 truck position to convert an obstacle into the means of leading the house away.

specificity.evidence: A1 house, road and surveyor establish the domestic problem and impossible explanation; B2 supplies the ordinary alternative.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 repeated Slowly expresses strain while the concrete comparison corrects the proposed worker's actual job.
